records.label: Secure context (HTTPS)
records.detail: secure context over https://hsgwyuki0429-design.github.io

records.label: iOS/Safari (UA guess)
records.detail: Guessed from the user-agent string. UA sniffing is not a measurement — iPadOS reports a Macintosh UA and any UA can be overridden. This record is barred from backing a phase pass criterion.

records.label: getUserMedia
records.detail: getUserMedia is present in a secure context. Not invoked in Phase 0 — opening the camera is Phase 1 (CAM-001), and probing it here would trigger a permission prompt

records.label: Video input devices
records.detail: 1 videoinput device(s) enumerated (labels hidden until camera permission is granted — expected)

records.label: Media constraints
records.detail: all constraints required by Phase 1/2 are supported (facingMode, width, height, frameRate, aspectRatio, deviceId)

records.label: Track capability control
records.detail: getCapabilities / getSettings / applyConstraints all present — Phase 2 can negotiate resolution and frame rate at runtime

records.label: WebAssembly (executed)
records.detail: compiled and executed a real 41-byte module: add(2,3) === 5

records.label: Web Worker round-trip
records.detail: blob worker round-trip succeeded in 2 ms

records.label: OffscreenCanvas
records.detail: drew and read back an exact pixel [10,20,30,255] from an OffscreenCanvas

records.label: Canvas -> Offscreen transfer
records.detail: transferControlToOffscreen returned a live OffscreenCanvas

records.label: OffscreenCanvas inside worker
records.detail: transferred an OffscreenCanvas into a worker, drew there and read back the exact pixel

records.label: SharedArrayBuffer
records.detail: SharedArrayBuffer is absent — requires COOP+COEP headers, which static hosting such as GitHub Pages cannot set. WASM threads must not be assumed.

records.label: WebGL2
records.detail: WebGL2 context created on Apple GPU

records.label: WebGPU
records.detail: requestAdapter() and requestDevice() both succeeded — a real GPU device was created

records.label: createImageBitmap
records.detail: created a real 4x4 ImageBitmap from a canvas

records.label: Canvas 2D readback
records.detail: main-thread canvas readback is byte-exact [10,20,30,255]

records.label: ImageCapture
records.detail: ImageCapture is present

records.label: WebCodecs VideoFrame
records.detail: VideoFrame is present — Phase 2 can pull frames without a canvas round-trip

records.label: requestVideoFrameCallback
records.detail: requestVideoFrameCallback is present — frame scheduling can be driven by real decoded frames rather than by rAF guessing

records.label: Storage quota
records.detail: storage quota reported by the platform: 38.4 GB (used 1.1 MB)

records.label: localStorage
records.detail: wrote, read and removed a real localStorage key

records.label: IndexedDB
records.detail: opened and deleted a real IndexedDB database — Phase 14 can persist worlds here

records.label: JS heap metrics
records.detail: performance.memory is absent (expected on WebKit) — the debug HUD must show MEMORY: UNAVAILABLE rather than a fabricated figure

records.label: WebXR
records.detail: navigator.xr is absent — WebXR is the only standards-track route to device depth or AR pose from a browser, so neither is reachable here

records.label: Native app bridge
records.detail: no window.webkit.messageHandlers bridge — the page is not hosted by a native app, so no native iOS framework can be reached from JavaScript

records.label: Camera depth
records.detail: no depth-related media constraint and no WebXR depth-sensing route (webxr=false) — DEPTH: UNAVAILABLE. Any depth used later must be labelled MONOCULAR ESTIMATE and never presented as native depth (§44)

records.label: Native ARKit
records.detail: ARKit has no JavaScript API. Probed for the only possible surface — a native message bridge — and found none. ARKit: UNAVAILABLE

records.label: RoomPlan
records.detail: RoomPlan has no JavaScript API. Probed for the only possible surface — a native message bridge — and found none. RoomPlan: UNAVAILABLE

records.label: Metric scale
records.detail: A monocular camera provides no absolute scale (§18, §90). No depth sensor, WebXR session or native bridge is reachable to supply one, so the world will be built in LOCAL UNITS and SCALE stays UNKNOWN until something actually measures it.

records.label: DeviceMotion
records.detail: DeviceMotionEvent requires requestPermission() from inside a user gesture (iOS 13+). Not attempted automatically — tap the sensor probe button.

records.label: DeviceOrientation
records.detail: DeviceOrientationEvent requires requestPermission() from inside a user gesture (iOS 13+). Not attempted automatically — tap the sensor probe button.

spec.title: Secure context / HTTPS
spec.passCriteria: the page is running in a secure context
spec.failureCondition: plain http on a non-localhost origin — camera can never work there

testResults.reason: secure context confirmed by direct measurement

spec.title: Camera API availability (API only, no permission prompt)
spec.expected: camera.getUserMedia = AVAILABLE and every constraint Phase 1/2 needs is supported
spec.passCriteria: getUserMedia is a function, page is secure, no required constraint missing
spec.failureCondition: mediaDevices undefined, getUserMedia missing, insecure, or a constraint missing

testResults.reason: the camera API surface Phase 1 needs is present; opening a stream is deferred to CAM-001

spec.title: WebGPU determined by functional probe
spec.expected: state AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE, decided by executing the API
spec.passCriteria: state is AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE and method is FUNCTIONAL_PROBE
spec.failureCondition: state UNKNOWN/ERROR, or decided from the UA string instead of the API

testResults.observed: AVAILABLE via FUNCTIONAL_PROBE — requestAdapter() and requestDevice() both succeeded — a real GPU device was created
testResults.reason: WebGPU state was decided by actually calling the API; UNAVAILABLE is a passing outcome because §8 asks for a correct report, not for WebGPU to exist

spec.title: DeviceMotion determined after user gesture
spec.input: user tap -> DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission(), then a 2000 ms listen window
spec.expected: a determined state; when granted, >= 5 events carrying finite sensor values
spec.passCriteria: state in {AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED}; AVAILABLE requires real data
spec.failureCondition: AVAILABLE claimed with no arriving events, or non-finite sample values

testResults.observed: PERMISSION_REQUIRED — DeviceMotionEvent requires requestPermission() from inside a user gesture (iOS 13+). Not attempted automatically — tap the sensor probe button.
testResults.reason: DeviceMotion cannot be determined until the user taps the sensor probe; PENDING holds Phase 0 at TESTING rather than rounding up to PASS

spec.title: DeviceOrientation determined after user gesture
spec.input: user tap -> DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission(), then a 2000 ms listen window
spec.expected: a determined state; when granted, >= 5 events with finite alpha/beta/gamma
spec.passCriteria: state in {AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED}; AVAILABLE requires real data
spec.failureCondition: AVAILABLE claimed with no arriving events, or non-finite sample values

testResults.observed: PERMISSION_REQUIRED — DeviceOrientationEvent requires requestPermission() from inside a user gesture (iOS 13+). Not attempted automatically — tap the sensor probe button.
testResults.reason: DeviceOrientation cannot be determined until the user taps the sensor probe; PENDING holds Phase 0 at TESTING rather than rounding up to PASS

spec.title: WebAssembly compiles and executes
spec.input: a 41-byte hand-assembled module exporting add(i32,i32)->i32, instantiated at runtime
spec.passCriteria: instantiation succeeds and the export returns exactly 5
spec.failureCondition: instantiation throws, or the result is not 5

testResults.reason: a real module was compiled and executed, so wasm is usable for Phase 3/4 hot loops

spec.title: Web Worker round-trip
spec.input: a Blob-URL worker; post {ping: token}; 3000 ms timeout
spec.passCriteria: echo matches and arrives before the timeout
spec.failureCondition: timeout, error event, or token mismatch

testResults.observed: AVAILABLE — blob worker round-trip succeeded in 2 ms
testResults.reason: workers function, so §21 (no long image processing on the UI thread) is achievable

spec.title: Offscreen pixel readback exactness
spec.passCriteria: byte-exact readback; if OffscreenCanvas is absent, the declared main-thread fallback must be exact instead
spec.failureCondition: no exact readback path exists on either route

testResults.reason: pixel readback is byte-exact, so grayscale conversion in Phase 2 will not be corrupted by colour management

spec.title: Depth / ARKit / RoomPlan / Scale honesty
spec.expected: depth, ARKit, RoomPlan reported UNAVAILABLE unless a real API was found; metric scale UNKNOWN
spec.passCriteria: no unsupported claim of availability, and none of these records uses INFERENCE
spec.failureCondition: any AVAILABLE without a probe that found a real API, or scale != UNKNOWN in Phase 0

testResults.observed: depth=UNAVAILABLE, arkit=UNAVAILABLE, roomplan=UNAVAILABLE, scale=UNKNOWN, webxr=UNAVAILABLE, bridge=UNAVAILABLE
testResults.reason: nothing is claimed that the platform cannot actually provide; DEPTH, ARKit and RoomPlan are reported as measured absences and SCALE stays UNKNOWN (§44, §90)

spec.title: Matrix integrity, export and round-trip
spec.input: the capability matrix plus the evidence draft (device, leg signals, transitions, log)
spec.expected: JSON round-trips exactly; no NaN/Infinity/undefined; every record has id, state, method, timestamp
spec.passCriteria: round-trip deep-equality, zero integrity issues, complete records, no INFERENCE backing a criterion

testResults.reason: the matrix is complete, finite and losslessly savable, so §7 "the matrix is savable" is a checked property rather than a claim

spec.title: Phase Lock blocks Phase 1 while Phase 0 is unpassed
spec.input: PhaseRegistry state and the rendered START SCAN control
spec.expected: registry refuses entry to Phase 1, and the UI control agrees with the registry
spec.passCriteria: canEnter(1) === false while Phase 0 is not PASSED; the control is disabled whenever entry is forbidden or Phase 1 is unimplemented, and its label says which
spec.failureCondition: the UI offers an action the registry forbids, or forbids one it allows

testResults.observed: phase0=TESTING, phase1=BLOCKED, canEnter(1)=false, startScanDisabled=true ("START SCAN — LOCKED")
testResults.reason: Phase Lock holds and the UI reflects engine state exactly, so there is no control that could imply capability the engine does not have

spec.title: Probe budget
spec.input: summed duration of all non-gesture probes
spec.failureCondition: exceeded — advisory only, a slow adapter query is a performance fact

testResults.observed: 33 ms of probing (budget 1500 ms); slowest: storage.indexedDB=12ms, camera.enumerateDevices=8ms, compute.worker=3ms
testResults.reason: capability detection is within its time budget

spec.title: Video input device enumeration
spec.expected: at least one videoinput entry (labels may be hidden before permission)
spec.failureCondition: zero video inputs — advisory, since an empty pre-permission list is a known browser behaviour

testResults.reason: at least one camera is enumerable before permission
